title: Map each logical artifact name to its contract path by splitting on ':' and '.'

facts.note: Task or text names a logical artifact (colon/dot-separated name) in any context: plans, wagons, WMBTs, acceptances, docs, code, tooling or config.
Any file or text (document, code, tooling, config) references, creates or checks a contract file or directory path. Not restricted to any document type.

values: artifact name does not resolve to the stated contract path
facts.note: Needs a detector that splits each artifact name on ':' and '.' and compares it with the referenced or existing contract path.

fires: Any task derives, references or checks the physical contract path for a logical artifact name, e.g. a plan or wagon stating where an artifact's schema lives.
An acceptance, doc, code, tooling or config references a contract path for a named artifact.
A new variant (dot suffix) or plural aspect is introduced and its schema location must be stated.
Naming or cardinality work that also states or derives the contract path of the artifact.
doesNotFire: Text mentions a contract path with no logical artifact name to map from or to.
Deciding singular vs plural aspect (cardinality-from-aspect convention), provided no contract path is derived, referenced or checked in the same work.
Composing the artifact name itself (naming-pattern convention), provided no contract path is derived, referenced or checked in the same work.

given: Any work (e.g. a plan, wagon, WMBT, acceptance, doc, code or tooling) involves a logical artifact name such as scenario:fragment or sensory:gesture.raw.
when: You derive, reference or check the contract path where that artifact's schema lives.
then: Derive the physical path by splitting the name on ':' and '.': each segment is a directory level under contracts/, the final segment the filename: <variant>.schema.json if a variant exists, else <aspect>.schema.json, or no file for a directory reference.
prefer: Singular aspect -> one object schema named after the aspect.
Plural aspect with a concrete collection -> array schema {type: array, items: $ref ../singular}.
Plural aspect that only groups related schemas -> directory reference, no schema file.
avoid: Stating a contract path that does not follow the split rule for the named artifact.
Inventing a schema file for a directory reference, or naming the file after the aspect when a variant exists.
why: A deterministic mapping lets anyone locate an artifact's contract from its name alone, so names and files cannot drift.
evidence: For each artifact name referenced, splitting on ':' and '.' yields exactly the referenced contract directory and filename.
Physical form matches the aspect: singular -> object schema, plural with array -> array schema whose items $ref ../singular, plural grouping -> directory with no schema file.
verifier_detail: Algorithm: segments = split(artifact, /[:.]/); path = 'contracts/' + segments[0..-1].join('/'); file = variant ? variant+'.schema.json' : (directory_reference ? none : aspect+'.schema.json').

Reference examples: scenario:fragment -> contracts/scenario/fragment/fragment.schema.json (singular object); scenario:fragments -> contracts/scenario/fragments/fragments.schema.json (array schema); commons:ux:foundations -> contracts/commons/ux/foundations/ (directory reference, no file); sensory:gesture.raw -> contracts/sensory/gesture/raw.schema.json (variant becomes filename); commons:ux:foundations:color.primary -> contracts/commons/ux/foundations/color/primary.schema.json.

Term physical_form ('Three physical forms': how a plural/singular artifact materializes on disk): directory_reference = logical grouping, no concrete schema file (plural aspect referencing a collection of related schemas); array_schema = plural aspect with a concrete array schema ({type: array, items: $ref ../singular}); singular_schema = singular aspect = single object schema.
Per the examples, when no variant exists the aspect is both the last directory and the filename stem; when a variant exists the variant is the filename and is not a directory.
